GOOD TO KNOW

A few things
you might be wondering.

What comes in my order?

One black-and-blue adjustable back stretcher: the base, curved massage board, and soft central cushion. The price is $29.

How do I adjust the height?

The base has three positions for the end of the massage board. These create an arch of approximately 2, 3, or 4 inches. Adjust it only when it is not in use and check that both ends are securely fitted.

Does it need assembly?

Yes, a simple setup: insert the cushion, fit both ends of the board into the base, and select the height. The step-by-step diagram above shows the process.

How much is shipping, and when will it arrive?

Shipping is free. Your order is delivered within 2 days.

How do I pay?

Select “Get mine” to open the Whop checkout and complete your purchase. Available payment methods and the final amount are shown there.

Can I order more than one?

This offer is for one back stretcher at $29 per order. There are no bundles or quantity selections.
